sections.text: Introduction

This procedurs explains the steps required to check 
the value of DEW POINT of SF6 gas. The above model DP 19 - GEC is specialy 
designed for field use, the measurements are made at pressure 10 mp - 10 bar.

The measurements are based on the chilled mirror 
principle which guarantees direct and precise measurement of the actual humidity

The first draft 
was initiated and tested by eng. Naser El Sayed Abd 
EL-Aziz, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, 
approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abdel-Baset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... 
 etc

The circuit breaker is open, 
 isolated and properly earthed.

Make sure that the measuring gas 
 outlet (no.2 fig.2) is open.

Make sure that the power supply 
 is 220Vac and the voltage selector switch of the instrument is 220v

Make sure that the gas pressure 
 not exceed more than "10" bar

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check the Condition of the 
Instrument before use and all tupes and couplings must be 
Flushed with Dry Gas

Check Dew Point Mirror as 
follow:

Close the control valve 
completely.
Open the flow meter valve.

Open the control valve 
slowly unit gas flow of 30 - 40 L / H is indicated.
Press the nains switch.

Press the mode switch, now 
both switches are illuminated.

Check dew point mirror 
condition as follow:
- The indicator needle is in the 
middle of the red field means correct
- The indicator needle moves towards 
the red field but remains in the green field means contaminated

In case of contaminated 
mirror, it must be cleaned as follow:
-
Wait until the temprature indicator 
shows ambient temprature because if mirror temprature is below 
ambient temprature when opening the measuring head, dew will form on the mirror
-
Close the control valve.
-
Open the measuring head.
-
Clean the mirror.
-
Install the front part of the 
measuring.
-
If the indicator is now in the 
middle of the red field, the mirror is clean, if it remains with in the green 
field or at the edge of the red field, set the indicator needle with light intensity 
potentiometer (no. 9 figure1) to the middle of the red field
-
If the range of the light intensity 
potentiometer is not sufficient, lamp and photocell in the front part of 
the measuring head must be cleaned.

sections.text: Measurement

Close the control valve 
completely.

Open flowmeter valve 
completely.

Open control valve slowly 
until the required gas flow of 30 - 40 L/H is reached.

Press the mode switch to 
check the mirror condition as described above.

Release the mode switch 
(light is off), the instrument starts cooling until dew point is reached and 
needle moves in to the green field.

Wait until the indication 
of the digital display stabilizes.
Read the dew point.

Determine the moisture 
contenes from the chart (fig. 3) in PPMv.

Mains switch (on/off)
By prossing this button, the instrument will be switched on (button illuminated)

Mode switch (mirror check 
/ measurement)
This switch selects the operating function (measurement / mirror chick). To 
measure dew - point the switch is released and measurement - mode is selected.

mirror condition, the switch is pressed and the mirror - check mode is selected.
